response.sql: WITH account_figures AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS average_signed_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS average_balance FROM account_figures;
